verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly lists a first-party Code References feature, and a user independently praises it for answering "where is this flag used in code?". Independent users also report that LD analytics surface stale or unused flags, flags only ever evaluated to the default, and let teams mark flags temporary vs permanent to cut tech debt. missing for 10: substantive first-party documentation (the code-references and stale-flag evidence is a bare docs title plus community reports), and evidence of a workflow that drives actual removal of flag code from the codebase.
